simple.meaning: יְקוּם (yᵉqûwm) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Deuteronomy, beginning at Genesis 7:4. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יְקוּם (H3351) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows יְקוּם through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: יְקוּם (yᵉqûwm) / H3351 is tracked through Genesis 7:4, Genesis 7:23, Deuteronomy 11:6. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

timeline.evidenceText: In seven days, I will cause it to rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights. I will destroy every living thing that I have made from the surface of the ground.”

Every living thing was destroyed that was on the surface of the ground, including man, livestock, creeping things, and birds of the sky. They were destroyed from the earth. Only Noah was left, and those who were with him in the ship.
